title: Decision Nº 068/010/2004 CC.D of December 07, 2004
text:
KINGDOM OF CAMBODIA 
Nation Religion King 
 
The Constitutional Council 
 CASE 
Nº 089/012/200 4 
Of November 11, 2004 
 Decision 
Nº 068/010/2004 CC.D 
Of December 07, 2004 
The Constitutional Council 
 
- Seen the Constitution of the Kingdom of Cambodia of 1993; 
- Seen Preah Reach Kram Nº CS/RKM/0498/06 of April 8, 1998 on the 
Organization and the Functioning of the Constitutional Council; 
- Seen Preah Reach Kram Nº 02/NS/94 of July 20, 1994 on the Organization 
and the Functioning of the Council of Ministers; 
- Seen the letter Nº 304 NA of November 10, 200 4 from Samdech HENG 
SAMRIN , Acting President of the National Assembly, requesting the 
Constitutional Council to review the constitutionality of the Law on the 
Establishment of Ministry of Social Affairs, Veterans and Youth 
Rehabilitation, letter received by the Secretariat General of the Constitutional 
Council on November 11, 2004. 
 
Having heard the rapporteur, 
Having deliberated in compliance with the law, 
 
- Whereas the National Assembly and the Senate have duly implemented the 
procedures provi ded for in the Article 113N for adopting the Law on the 
Establishment of Ministry of Social Affairs, Veterans, and Youth 
Rehabilitation; 
- Whereas the request for reviewing the constitutionality of the Organic Law 
by the Acting President of the National Assembly is in compliance with the 
constitution (sentence 1, Article 140N of the Constitution.); 
- Whereas the decision on the consti tutionality of the Organic Law is within 
the competence of the Constitutional Council (sentence 2, Article 140N of 
the Constitution.); 
- Whereas the procedure of legislation and the adoption of the Organic Law 
has no provision contrary to the Cons titution; 
- Whereas the substance of the Articles 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 of the Law on the 
Establishment of Ministry of Social Affairs, Veterans, and Youth 
Rehabilitation does not contain any provision contradictory to the 
Constitution. 
 
Decides: 
 
 Article 1 : The Law on the Establishment of Ministry of Social Affairs, 
Veterans and, Youth Rehabilitation adopted by the 
National Assembly on October 27, 2004 and entirely 
reviewed by the Senate on November 05, 2004 is declared 
constitutional. 
 
 Article 2 : The decision made in the plenary session of the Constitutio nal 
Council in Phnom Penh on December 07, 2004 shall be final 
without recourse, shall have authority over all the instituted 
powers as stipulated in the Constitution, and shall be published 
in the “Journal Officiel”. 
 
 Phnom Penh , December 07, 2004 
 For the Constitutional Council 
 The President 
 Signed and Sealed 
 
 
 BIN CHHIN
summary: Decision Nº 068/010/2004 CC.D of December 07, 2004: Request of Samdech HENG SAMRIN , Acting President of the National Assembly, to the Constitutional Council for reviewing the constitutionality of the Law on the Establishment of Ministry of Social Affairs, Veterans and Youth Rehabilitation.
